card.name: Tens digit in creatinine clearance cutoffs
card.fires_on: The first digit (usually 3, also 5 or 6) of a two-digit round number like 30, 50 or 60. It appears after "less than" or "greater than" in kidney-function thresholds, and also in timed lists.
